overview_description.description: NFTScoring is a trading platform and marketplace for the NFT market. Unlike all other traditional NFT marketplaces, they provide a proper trading venue for both professional traders and casual investors. The platform is developing a new set of tools required for the NFT market to professionalize, integrate, and thus enter the mainstream. It was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in the Czech Republic.
